name: alice
description: Music Distribution Made Easy. ALICE helps Soundscape members prepare and submit music releases for review, get distribution and marketing guidance, and track performance across streaming platforms as new data becomes available. ALICE is currently in invitation-only testing. Anyone can install the plugin, but sign-in is limited to invited accounts. Starting in Q1 2027, access will gradually expand to Soundscape members with a signed distribution agreement.
